request: Scale the part 10x. Add drafts of 2 degrees to all vertical surfaces, with flat bottom surface as a hinge. Add rounds R=1mm to all inner edges and R=3mm to all outer edges. Exclude edges, inner or outer, on the flat bottom surface. Add two cylinder features with D=6mm and inner hole D=3mm. Cylinders should be spaced 30mm apart and shall be placed centered with respect to the main part. They should start on the flat bottom surface level and reach all the way to the part wall on the top side

actions.relational_constraint: Apply the same scale factor to the entire part.
actions.unresolved_reference: The body or bodies constituting the part must be identified in the CAD model.

actions.target: all vertical surfaces of the scaled part
actions.relational_constraint: Use the flat bottom surface as the draft hinge or neutral reference.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the flat bottom surface, determine the model direction defining vertical, identify all surfaces vertical relative to that direction, and determine the required draft direction.

actions.relational_constraint: Exclude every inner edge lying on the flat bottom surface.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify which edges are inner or concave, identify the flat bottom surface, and determine which inner edges are on that surface.

actions.relational_constraint: Exclude every outer edge lying on the flat bottom surface.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify which edges are outer or convex, identify the flat bottom surface, and determine which outer edges are on that surface.

actions.relational_constraint: The two cylinders must be spaced 30 mm apart, placed as a centered pair with respect to the main part, start at the level of the flat bottom surface, and extend to the part wall on the top side.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the main part, its applicable center, the flat bottom surface level, the top-side part wall, the cylinder-axis direction, and whether the stated spacing is measured between cylinder axes, centers, or surfaces.

actions.operation: Create an inner hole in each cylinder feature
actions.target: the two newly created cylinder features
actions.relational_constraint: Each hole must be internal to its corresponding cylinder.
actions.unresolved_reference: The request does not explicitly define hole depth, termination, axis direction, or whether each hole must be concentric with its cylinder.
